scope: finite square carriers, fixed finite classical visible protocol, hidden Kraus sums
model: two noncommuting visible success outcomes, three registered steps

protocol.visible_records: original outcome strings only; hidden Kraus indices are never appended

preparation.external_reference: not modelled; no stabilized or diamond guarantee

resource_units.preparation: report separately; not assigned zero for physical advantage claims

implementation_scope.general_convex_test: one-step randomization with the same weights on each declared observation fibre
implementation_scope.quantifier: full-space labelled instruments unless a separate support/fixed-input certificate explicitly says otherwise

comparison.observable: full visible-record and terminal-quantum CQ state
comparison.acceptance_event: all three original outcomes are in the registered success set

evidence_policy.numpy_scipy: numerical residuals and LP candidates only
evidence_policy.sympy: exact symbolic witness identities, not a general Lean proof
